raw.notable_prerequisites:
an instant or sorcery spell in hand.
Mana available to cast the instant or sorcery spell.
raw.steps:
Cast the instant or sorcery spell.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting the instant or sorcery spell.
Holding priority, activate twinning staff by paying {7} targeting Narset's Reversal, copying Narset's Reversal twice.
Resolve one copy of Narset's Reversal targeting another copy of Narset's Reversal, copying it twice and returning the targeted copy to your hand.
Repeat step 4.

raw.easy_prerequisites: You have an additional instant or sorcery card in hand with valid targets as applicable.
raw.mana_needed: {1}{U}{U}{R}{R} plus enough mana to cast the additional instant or sorcery
raw.steps:
Cast any instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Reiterate by paying its mana cost, targeting the instant or sorcery cast in step 1.
Cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, copying Reiterate targeting the spell cast in step 1 and returning the original Reiterate to your hand.
Cast Reiterate by paying its mana cost, copying the copy of Reiterate, targeting the copy of Reiterate.
Resolve the copy of Reiterate, creating a copy of Reiterate targeting the copy of Reiterate.
Repeat step 5.

You have enough mana to cast Twinflame
raw.steps:

Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage.

raw.notable_prerequisites: You control two additional lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{U}.
produces: Near-infinite mana lands you control can produce
raw.steps:
Activate Primal Wellspring and the two additional lands by tapping them, adding {1}{U}{U} and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Cast Frantic Search by paying {2}{U}.
Primal Wellspring's ability triggers, copying Frantic Search.
Resolve the copy of Frantic Search, looting twice and untapping Primal Wellspring and the two other lands.
Activate Primal Wellspring and those two lands, adding at least {1}{U}{U} and creating another delayed triggered ability.
Cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting Frantic Search.
Primal Wellspring's ability triggers, creating a copy of Narset's Reversal targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying the original Narset's Reversal and returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the new copy of Narset's Reversal, creating a copy of Frantic Search and returning the original Frantic Search to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Frantic Search, looting twice and untapping Primal Wellspring and two other lands.
Repeat.

produces: Infinite black mana that can only be spent to cast instant and sorcery spells
Infinite blue mana that can only be spent to cast instant and sorcery spells
raw.steps:
Activate Cormela by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant and/or sorcery spells.
Cast Twinflame by paying {1}{R}.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Twinflame, creating a token copy of Cormela.
 Put the tapped Cormela into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cormela dies, triggering itself, returning Twinflame from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

raw.notable_prerequisites: You control up to two mana-producing lands that can tap to produce at least {2}.
raw.steps:
Activate Primal Wellspring and two other mana-producing lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Frantic Search by paying {2}{U}, ensuring to use the mana produced by Primal Wellspring.
Primal Wellspring triggers, copying Frantic Search.
Resolve the copy of Frantic Search, causing you to loot twice, untap Primal Wellspring and untap the two other lands.
Holding priority, activate Primal Wellspring and two other mana-producing lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{R}.
Cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {4}{R}{R}, targeting Frantic Search, ensuring to use the mana produced by Primal Wellspring.
Primal Wellspring triggers, copying Reiterate targeting Frantic Search.
Resolve both Reiterates, copying Frantic Search twice and returning the original Reiterate to your hand.
Resolve the first copy of Frantic Search, causing you to loot twice, untap Primal Wellspring and untap the two other lands.
 Activate Primal Wellspring and two other mana-producing lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{R}.
Resolve the second copy of Frantic Search, causing you to loot twice, untap Primal Wellspring and untap the two other lands.
Repeat from step 5.
